title: Signed line algebraic pullback
statement: Let F be the specified module pullback for a:R→U_*S. Given compatible unit presentations identifying S with the set inverse image of R and identifying the underlying sets of F with the set inverse image, there exists an AlgebraicInverseImage whose module functor is F, whose ring-underlying comparison is the inverse ring presentation, and whose module-underlying comparison is the given one. Its additive and scalar operation comparisons satisfy the defining graph equations. All fields are constructed from these presentations.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Choose precisely the given module functor and given underlying comparison, and choose the inverse ring presentation. Pullback-unit naturality and hom_ext prove compatibility with zero and addition. Apply binary_graph to addition and scalar multiplication and constant_graph to zero, using the actual module-unit section formulas. These operations supply every field of AlgebraicInverseImage.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.

theorem algebraic_pullback_of_presentations
    (a : (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R ⟶
      (U.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).obj
        ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))
    (pr : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := U)
      ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat)).obj R)
      ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat)).obj S))
    (hr : pr.unit = (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat)).map a)
    (em : pull a ⋙ toSheaf _ ⋙ sheafCompose K
        (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}) ≅
      (toSheaf _ ⋙ sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})) ⋙
        sheafPullback U (Type (max u v w)) J K)
    (he : ∀ (M : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules R) (V : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj V),
      (em.hom.app M).hom.app (U.op.obj V)
        (ringedSitePullbackSection a (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes a)
          M V.unop x) =
        ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous U (Type (max u v w)) J K).unit.app
          ((toSheaf _ ⋙ sheafCompose J
            (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})).obj M)).hom.app V x) :
    ∃ I : AlgebraicInverseImage (sheafPullback U (Type (max u v w)) J K) R S,
      I.modules = pull a ∧ I.ringUnderlying = pr.iso.symm ∧ HEq I.moduleUnderlying em
